name: Message
description: Displays user or assistant conversation turns, including sending, streaming and failure states.

from.description: Who wrote the message: the user's bubble sits at the end, the assistant's reply is flush

status.description: Where the message stands: pending shows Sending…, streaming a still caret at the end, error a failure block

timestamp.description: When the message was sent; shown in the meta line

avatar.description: Opt-in avatar slot, usually Message.Avatar. No avatar is drawn by default

actions.description: Actions for the message (copy, regenerate), shown on hover or focus where a pointer hovers, always on touch

onRetry.description: Retry a failed message; the failure block offers Try again

when: Individual turns in a chat transcript
User and assistant turns that must read differently
Turns carrying copy, regenerate, or feedback actions
whenNot: Plain text with no chat context (use Text)
Threads with nested replies (use Card with a custom layout)
guidelines: Always set from; it places the turn and picks the reading
Events such as a model switch or a joined user are ConversationList.Event, not a message
A string from the assistant renders as markdown; from the user it keeps its line breaks
status covers pending, streaming and error; error adds the failure block with Try again when onRetry is set
No avatars by default; pass avatar when a conversation has more than two people
The user's bubble caps at 80% of the measure so the two sides stay distinct
Show one waiting pattern: ThinkingIndicator before the reply starts, the caret while it streams
accessibility: A streaming message sets aria-busy until it completes
The failure block is an alert with its words and a labelled Try again
Actions are reachable by keyboard and shown on focus; they are always visible on touch
The timestamp is a time element with a machine-readable date

examples.name: User Message
examples.description: The user's words in a band bubble at the end, capped at 80% of the measure.
examples.code:
<Message from="user">
  <Message.Content>Which files break the workspace rules?</Message.Content>
</Message>

examples.name: Assistant Message
examples.description: The reply is flush and renders markdown.

examples.name: Streaming
examples.description: A still caret at the end while the reply arrives.
examples.code:
const partial = "Two files need updated imports…";

<Message from="assistant" status="streaming">
  <Message.Content>{partial}</Message.Content>
</Message>

examples.name: Sending
examples.description: The meta line says Sending… until the message lands.
examples.code:
<Message from="user" status="pending">
  <Message.Content>Summarise the changes on main.</Message.Content>
</Message>

examples.name: Failed
examples.description: The failure block says what happened and offers Try again.

examples.name: With Timestamp
examples.description: A relative time in the meta line.
examples.code:
const sentAt = new Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 30);

<Message from="user" timestamp={sentAt}>
  <Message.Content>Thanks!</Message.Content>
</Message>

examples.name: With Actions
examples.description: Copy and regenerate beside the meta line.

examples.name: With Avatar
examples.description: Opt in when more than two people talk.

relations.note: Messages are typically used within ConversationList
Use Avatar component for custom avatar content
Show ThinkingIndicator while awaiting assistant response

propsSummary: timestamp: Date - when the message was sent
onRetry: () => void - Try again on a failed message
Error.children: ReactNode - what went wrong (defaults: Not sent. / This reply didn't finish.)
Avatar.src: string - image URL for avatar
Avatar.alt: string - alt text for image avatar
